name: Veto (last one standing)
use_when: the group knocks options out until one is left: each person gets a veto or two
'everyone gets one veto', 'veto game', 'cross off what you hate', 'knock them out', 'last one standing'
people care more about avoiding what they hate than voting for a favorite
dont_use_when: people vote for what they want (use poll)
nobody wants a say and Muse should just pick (use wheel)
several categories at once like place, budget and time (use reels)
guarantees: each person in the chat vetoes at most the set number of options; a veto strikes one option and records who did it
the last option standing wins; a veto can never strike the last one
when everyone has used their vetoes, or someone taps Decide, the server seed picks one of those still in, shown only once confirmed
a late joiner gets their own vetoes; a leaver's vetoes are lifted and those options come back in

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Where are we eating?'

options.description: Options from the chat, 2 to 6, short

vetoesEach.description: Vetoes per person, 1 to 3; 1 unless the chat says otherwise

detail.description: One line from the chat shown with the winner, e.g. 'Table for 6 at 7:30'; empty if none
